ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious High IntegrityLevel Conhost Legacy Option
ruleDefinitions.description: ForceV1 asks for information directly from the kernel space. Conhost connects to the console application. High IntegrityLevel means the process is running with elevated privileges, such as an Administrator context.

sequences.query: ((process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-12288") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*conhost\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*0xffffffff.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-ForceV1.*")))
